_doc: Where this planet hides the pieces of Lumi's looks (design spec section 13; systems/finds.gd; the piece list is data/cosmetics.json). Looks are rare: the planet hands out ONE design, `set`, spread over its cities with the last piece in the last city, and a few loose colours. Pieces of other designs are not placed here. source_shut_at_stage: until a city's source is a job of its own, the source counts as shut down when the city reaches this regrowth stage (EventBus.source_shut_down(district) releases the find at once when something emits it). reveal_s: seconds a found piece is shown on Lumi. finds[]: id (never changes once shipped: the save holds the ids already taken), piece or pieces (ids in data/cosmetics.json), hint (the one line the Locker shows under these pieces while they are unfound: where on this planet that kind of thing turns up; without it the piece's own or its slot's general hint shows), where: 'buried' = a paint tin or lens chip under an ordinary hex of `district` ('' = open ground outside every city): each hex cleaned there from the from_hex-th on turns it up with chance_per_hex (about one in 40), and the by_hex-th cleaned hex turns it up for certain, so no colour is missed; one buried find per hex at most, in list order. 'wreck' = an old robot of this planet's design under the trash of `district`, off the main path: it stands on one dirty hex between ring_share[0] and ring_share[1] of the way from the city's middle to its edge (picked from the planet's seed) and gives its pieces when that hex is cleared, or when Lumi uses the wreck once the world has placed one there (Finds.register_site). 'source' = given when the source of `district` is shut down. 'secret' = given when the curiosity `egg` is found. The first buried find of the first city is the player's first piece (about minute 25 of play, minute 12 to 16 for the bot) and brings the Locker.
